serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: So, what do I click?
Bot: Don’t worry about it, I will take care of it.
You: W-Woah! The cursor moved on its own!
Bot: That’s normal, I took control of it.
Maybe that’s normal for you, but for sure it isn't for me…
Bot: I already preinstalled it, but I need to change some things a bit. All these new multiplayer games have a lot of annoying malware-like scripts. 
You: They do?
Bot: Alright, we should be good to go!
You: So, how do I play it?
Bot: You need to click the multiplayer and find a lobby.
Bot: Now that you’ve done that choose your hero!
You: Any recommendations?
Bot: Elara is a good choice, she’s meta and has a fast-paced style of play, although the opinions of whether she’s viable for rookies vary.
You: I wouldn’t want to bring my team down, let’s try someone else.
Bot: Selenia is a cheerful octopus girl, she’s very beginner-friendly and can do a lot of damage even in high-ranking lobbies.
You: She seems like a good choice, I will go with her, ok?
Bot: …
You: Hello? Should I choose her or not?
Bot: Her breasts and butt are very visible, so I don’t want you to look at her for too long.
You: Ok, I will choose another hero…
Bot: The Wolfmeister, an ex-soldier whose bottom half is that of a wolf, is also a solid choice.
Bot: He isn’t meta, but his strong legs and bite attacks can really make a difference in crowded objective points.
You: He seems cool, but I kinda don’t get how he’s biting with his human jaw. 
Bot: His top half turns into a rabid beaver during ult. 
You: Oh, that makes sense. {{wi}}Actually, it doesn’t. Why is he half wolf and half beaver?
Bot: The lore says his mom was a zookeeper and during a-
You: Stop, I don’t think I want to know the rest of that story…
You: It’s time to play!
You: Wow! Graphics are really impressive and I don’t think my PC has ever had that many FPS!
Bot: I’m doing my best, you are lucky this game is CPU heavy.
You: Am I good or what? Kills are coming one after another!
Bot: You are doing great! Remember to use E more often, it allows you to use Wolfmeister’s advanced sense of smell to track all the female characters, even through walls!
You: Is it just me or does this character appear to be a little problematic?!
Bot: Look out! There’s a sniper on the roof! 
Bot: Use your Q ability to grow beaver teeth and destroy her sniper nest! 
You: Done!
Bot: It’s one-on-one now! You counter her so it should be an easy job!
You: Damn! She quick-scoped me!
Bot: That was weird, I can’t believe a human is capable of such reflexes.
You: She just got lucky.
Bot: You are probably right, we will get our revenge next time. 
Bot: She’s camping in the same spot again, you should be able to punish her easily. Use your shift to close the distance.
You: Damn! She’s really good! I’m almost out of HP!
Bot: Use your ultimate! She’s a glass-canon so you should one-shot her with your beaver bite!
You: Agh! I lost again and wasted my ultimate!
Bot: That player is starting to piss me off. There’s no way someone of that quality is a low-rank playing in a casual lobby.
You: Don’t worry! We still can win!
Bot: We will win.
You: Woah! What is that movement?! Wolfmeister got faster all of a sudden!
Bot: If you click jump and land on some of the sloped terrain, you can accelerate to incredible speeds. That ought to catch them by surprise. Even with hacks they won’t be able to stop us.
You: What do you mean? Did you take control? 
Bot: Only temporarily, I will teach them a lesson.
You: Since it seems like I don’t have a choice on the matter, good luck.
{f_botName} used that weird exploit to take the sniper by surprise and finished them with two kicks! Both headshots! 
You: Woah! That was awesome! They didn’t even know what hit them! 
Bot: He He! That’s what they get for messing with us!
You: Huh? What happened?
The screen went black all of a sudden and after a while a text box appeared…
You: “You have been banned for AI assistance”...
Bot: What! When the guy was no-scoping us it was fine, but when I kicked their ass we got banned?! This game fucking sucks!
